en: The Sūtra on the Incantation for the Teeth Spoken by the Buddha, translated by Zhu Tanwulan of the Eastern Jin Dynasty.
Namo Buddha. Namo Dharma. Namo Saṃgha of Bhikṣus. Namo Śāriputra and Mahāmaudgalyāyana.
His fame reaches as far as the Gandhamādana Mountain in the northern direction.
There is a king of worms named Chakhunu who dwells within such-and-such a tooth;
I now dispatch this messenger so that he shall not dare to eat that tooth.
As well as the tooth-root-insect and the tooth-edge-insect within the tooth root—
[if they do not immediately fall into the vessel and their heads split into seven pieces like a *kaurava* earthworm]—
May all my incantations be fulfilled according to my wishes.
The Buddha-spoken Sūtra on Incanting the Teeth.
